row.title: Executor pre-PR checks are targeted; the full suite gates the merge (CHECKS-TARGETED-1, EXEC-WATCHDOG-2, SPARK-BUSY-1)
row.body: The serial tests/foundation suite outlasts the 10 minute watchdog, so 12 of 12 runs on 2026-11-19 stalled before a PR and recorded 'failed: _Stall:' because _Stall subclassed Exception. The executor now runs the workflow lint, py_compile and the related test modules; the checks workflow on the PR still runs the whole suite as the required status. Stall is a BaseException, no repair attempt starts with under 150 s left, and the spark and chain stand down while an older executor run is queued or running (9 of 15 runs were cancelled pending jobs).
